description: Golden test set for ABC Bank RAG system

questions.question: What is the minimum balance for a Regular Savings Account?
questions.ground_truth: The minimum balance for a Regular Savings Account is Rs. 10,000.

questions.question: What is the minimum balance for a Premium Savings Account?
questions.ground_truth: The minimum balance for a Premium Savings Account is Rs. 100,000.

questions.question: What documents are required to open a savings account for a Pakistani national?
questions.ground_truth: Required documents are original CNIC, utility bill not older than 3 months, and 2 passport size photographs.

questions.question: What is the profit rate for a Regular Savings Account?
questions.ground_truth: The profit rate for a Regular Savings Account is 5% per annum.

questions.question: What is the minimum loan amount for a personal loan?
questions.ground_truth: The minimum personal loan amount is Rs. 50,000.

questions.question: What is the maximum personal loan amount for salaried employees?
questions.ground_truth: The maximum personal loan amount for salaried employees is Rs. 3,000,000.

questions.question: What is the interest rate for salaried government employees?
questions.ground_truth: The interest rate for salaried government employees is 18% per annum.

questions.question: What is the loan processing fee?
questions.ground_truth: The loan processing fee is 1% of the loan amount with a minimum of Rs. 2,500.

questions.question: What is the early repayment penalty for a personal loan?
questions.ground_truth: The early repayment penalty is 2% of the outstanding principal amount.

questions.question: What is the annual fee for a Classic credit card?
questions.ground_truth: The annual fee for a Classic credit card is Rs. 2,500.

questions.question: What is the markup rate on outstanding credit card balance?
questions.ground_truth: The markup rate on outstanding balance is 3.5% per month.

questions.question: What is the late payment fee for credit card?
questions.ground_truth: The late payment fee is Rs. 1,500 or 5% of the minimum due, whichever is higher.

questions.question: What is the minimum credit card payment due each month?
questions.ground_truth: The minimum payment due is 5% of the outstanding balance or Rs. 1,000, whichever is higher.

questions.question: What is the IBFT transfer charge for amounts up to Rs. 25,000?
questions.ground_truth: The IBFT charge for transfers up to Rs. 25,000 is Rs. 200 per transaction.

questions.question: Is RAAST transfer free?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, RAAST transfers are free and unlimited.

questions.question: What is the ATM cash withdrawal limit per day?
questions.ground_truth: The ATM cash withdrawal limit is Rs. 50,000 per day.

questions.question: How do I block a lost or stolen debit card?
questions.ground_truth: Call the helpline 0800-ABCBANK available 24 hours 7 days a week, or block through the ABC Bank mobile app.

questions.question: How do I file a complaint with ABC Bank?
questions.ground_truth: You can file a complaint by calling 0800-ABCBANK, visiting any branch, emailing complaints@abcbank.com, or using the mobile app complaint section.

questions.question: How long does ABC Bank take to resolve a simple complaint?
questions.ground_truth: Simple account and transaction complaints are resolved within 3 working days.

questions.question: What is the SBP Banking Mohtasib contact number?
questions.ground_truth: The SBP Banking Mohtasib contact number is 0800-200-00.

questions.question: What is the charge for a cheque book with 25 leaves?
questions.ground_truth: The charge for a cheque book with 25 leaves is Rs. 500.

questions.question: What is the annual fee for a Platinum credit card?
questions.ground_truth: The annual fee for a Platinum credit card is Rs. 10,000.

questions.question: What is the minimum age to apply for a personal loan?
questions.ground_truth: The minimum age to apply for a personal loan is 21 years.

questions.question: What is the maximum loan tenure for a personal loan?
questions.ground_truth: The maximum loan tenure is 60 months.

questions.question: What is the debit card replacement fee?
questions.ground_truth: The debit card replacement fee for lost or damaged card is Rs. 500.

questions.question: After how many days does a loan become delinquent?
questions.ground_truth: A loan is considered delinquent after 30 days of missed payment.

questions.question: What is the charge for a small locker annual rent?
questions.ground_truth: The small locker annual rent is Rs. 5,000.

questions.question: What is the withholding tax rate on profit for non-filers?
questions.ground_truth: The withholding tax rate on profit for non-filers is 30%.

questions.question: What is the minimum monthly income for a salaried personal loan applicant?
questions.ground_truth: The minimum monthly income for a salaried personal loan applicant is Rs. 30,000.

questions.question: How many free ATM withdrawals are allowed per month at other bank ATMs for premium accounts?
questions.ground_truth: Premium accounts get a maximum of 5 free transactions per month at other bank ATMs.
